Oneliner

Materials experiment to monitor atomic oxygen effects.
Description

Monitoring of the durability of exposed thin bonding wires, PCB tracks and lines (Atomic Oxygen effects). Verification of the system fault tolerance scheme. Acquisition of spacecraft environment and operating data. All firmware, in house developed baseband modulation schemes.
